L\sqrt{\frac{\ln(2T|\mathcal{H}|/\delta)}{T}}\leq r_{T}</annotation></semantics></math>. By applying the union bound over all <math id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p7.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="h\in H_{T-1}\subseteq\mathcal{H}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>h</mi><mo>∈</mo><msub><mi>H</mi><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>⊆</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h\in H_{T-1}\subseteq\mathcal{H}</annotation></semantics></math>, and all <math id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p7.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="h^{*}\in\mathcal{H}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>h</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo>∈</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h^{*}\in\mathcal{H}</annotation></semantics></math>, we have that</span></p>

<p id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p7.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p7.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Next, conditioning on the occurrence of this event, we will prove that <math id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p7.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h)-R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h^{\ast})\leq 2r_{T}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>R</mi><mtext>SPO</mtext></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>h</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><msub><mi>R</mi><mtext>SPO</mtext></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>h</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>T</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h)-R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h^{\ast})\leq 2r_{T}</annotation></semantics></math>. Since Claim <math id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p7.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(A)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(A)</annotation></semantics></math> holds for all <math id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p7.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t\leq T-1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t\leq T-1</annotation></semantics></math>, it implies that for any <math id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p7.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t\leq T-1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t\leq T-1</annotation></semantics></math>, <math id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p7.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sup_{h\in H_{t-1}}\left|\frac{1}{t}\sum_{i=1}^{t}Z^{\mathtt{i}}_{h}\right|\leq r_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mo>sup</mo><mrow><mi>h</mi><mo>∈</mo><msub><mi>H</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></msub><mrow><mo lspace="0em">|</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>t</mi></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>t</mi></msubsup><msubsup><mi>Z</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>𝚒</mi></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sup_{h\in H_{t-1}}\left|\frac{1}{t}\sum_{i=1}^{t}Z^{\mathtt{i}}_{h}\right|\leq r_{t}</annotation></semantics></math>. Thus, the condition in Lemma <a href="#A4.Thmtheorem1" title="Lemma D.1 ‣ D.1 Proof of Theorem ‣ Appendix D Proofs ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">D.1</span></a> holds, and by Lemma <a href="#A4.Thmtheorem1" title="Lemma D.1 ‣ D.1 Proof of Theorem ‣ Appendix D Proofs ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">D.1</span></a>, we have that <math id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p7.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="h^{*}\in H_{T-1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>h</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo>∈</mo><msub><mi>H</mi><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h^{*}\in H_{T-1}</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p8" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p8.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p8.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Since <math id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p8.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="h\in H_{T-1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>h</mi><mo>∈</mo><msub><mi>H</mi><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h\in H_{T-1}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p8.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="h^{*}\in H_{T-1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>h</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo>∈</mo><msub><mi>H</mi><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h^{*}\in H_{T-1}</annotation></semantics></math>, we have that <math id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p8.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\ell^{\mathtt{rew}}(h_{T};z_{t})-\ell^{\mathtt{rew}}(h^{*};z_{t})\leq r_{T}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">ℓ</mi><mi>𝚛𝚎𝚠</mi></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>h</mi><mi>T</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">ℓ</mi><mi>𝚛𝚎𝚠</mi></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>h</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>T</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\ell^{\mathtt{rew}}(h_{T};z_{t})-\ell^{\mathtt{rew}}(h^{*};z_{t})\leq r_{T}</annotation></semantics></math> in (<a href="#A4.E8" title="Equation 8 ‣ D.1 Proof of Theorem ‣ Appendix D Proofs ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">8</span></a>) and we obtain that
<math id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p8.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h)-R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h^{\ast})\leq 2r_{T}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>R</mi><mtext>SPO</mtext></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>h</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><msub><mi>R</mi><mtext>SPO</mtext></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>h</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>T</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h)-R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h^{\ast})\leq 2r_{T}</annotation></semantics></math> if <math id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p8.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\left|\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}Z^{\mathtt{t}}_{h}\right|\leq r_{T}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>T</mi></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>T</mi></msubsup><msubsup><mi>Z</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>𝚝</mi></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>≤</mo><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>T</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left|\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}Z^{\mathtt{t}}_{h}\right|\leq r_{T}</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p9" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p9.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p9.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Therefore, we obtain that Claim (A) holds for <math id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p9.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>T</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T</annotation></semantics></math> with probability at least <math id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p9.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1-\frac{\delta}{2T^{2}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mi>δ</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>T</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1-\frac{\delta}{2T^{2}}</annotation></semantics></math>. <math id="A4.Thmtheorem3.p9.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\square" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi mathvariant="normal">□</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\square</annotation></semantics></math></span></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<div id="A4.Thmtheorem5" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem5.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Proof D.5</span></span></h6>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold ltx_font_italic">Proof of Lemma <a href="#S2.Thmtheorem4" title='Lemma 2.4 (“Lipschitz-like” property of ℓ_"SPO" under directional margin condition) ‣ 2.3 Preliminaries for Theoretical Guarantees ‣ 2 Algorithm and Performance Guarantees ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach' class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.4</span></a><span id="A4.Thmtheorem5.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium">
From theorem 8 of <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib2" title="" class="ltx_ref">El Balghiti et al. (2022)</a></cite>, we know the following hold for any <math id="A4.Thmtheorem5.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\hat{c},w," display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">w</mi></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\hat{c},w,</annotation></semantics></math></span></span></p>
<table id="A4.Ex42" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

</table>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem5.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem5.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem5.p4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Adding these two inequalities and applying the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, we get</span></p>

<div id="A4.Thmtheorem5.p6" class="ltx_para">

<p id="A4.Thmtheorem5.p7.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem5.p7.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">where the first and third equations used Fact <a href="#Thmthm1" title="Fact 1 (Fact 1: The SPO loss is scale invariant.) ‣ 2.1 Algorithm Motivation ‣ 2 Algorithm and Performance Guarantees ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">1</span></a>, the first inequality used the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, the second inequality applied the upper bound of <math id="A4.Thmtheorem5.p7.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\|w^{*}(h_{1}(x))-w^{*}(h_{2}(x))\|" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>w</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>h</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><msup><mi>w</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>h</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\|w^{*}(h_{1}(x))-w^{*}(h_{2}(x))\|</annotation></semantics></math>.
 <math id="A4.Thmtheorem5.p7.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\square" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi mathvariant="normal">□</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\square</annotation></semantics></math></span></p>

<div id="A4.Thmtheorem6" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem6.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Proof D.6</span></span></h6>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold ltx_font_italic">Proof of Theorem <a href="#S2.Thmtheorem6" title="Theorem 2.6 (Sample complexity) ‣ 2.4 Risk Bound and Rates ‣ 2 Algorithm and Performance Guarantees ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.6</span></a><span id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium">
By Theorem <a href="#S2.Thmtheorem5" title="Theorem 2.5 (Risk Bound) ‣ 2.4 Risk Bound and Rates ‣ 2 Algorithm and Performance Guarantees ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.5</span></a>, with probability <math id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1-\delta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">δ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1-\delta</annotation></semantics></math> we have <math id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R_{\ell}(h_{\tau})-R_{\ell}(h^{*})\leq 2r_{\tau}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">ℓ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">h</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">τ</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">ℓ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">h</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">τ</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R_{\ell}(h_{\tau})-R_{\ell}(h^{*})\leq 2r_{\tau}</annotation></semantics></math> where <math id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r_{\tau}=2\gamma L\sqrt{\frac{\log(2\tau|\mathcal{H}|/\delta)}{\tau}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">τ</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">γ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mfrac><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">τ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">δ</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">τ</mi></mfrac></msqrt></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r_{\tau}=2\gamma L\sqrt{\frac{\log(2\tau|\mathcal{H}|/\delta)}{\tau}}</annotation></semantics></math>. Then <math id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R_{\ell}(h_{\tau})-R_{\ell}(h^{*})\leq\epsilon" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">ℓ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">h</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">τ</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">ℓ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">h</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">ϵ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R_{\ell}(h_{\tau})-R_{\ell}(h^{*})\leq\epsilon</annotation></semantics></math> is implied by
<math id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="2r_{\tau}=4\gamma L\sqrt{\frac{\log(2\tau|\mathcal{H}|/\delta)}{\tau}}\leq\epsilon" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">τ</mi></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">γ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mfrac><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">τ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">δ</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">τ</mi></mfrac></msqrt></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">ϵ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2r_{\tau}=4\gamma L\sqrt{\frac{\log(2\tau|\mathcal{H}|/\delta)}{\tau}}\leq\epsilon</annotation></semantics></math>,
which is equivalent to
<math id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\log(\frac{2\tau|\mathcal{H}|}{\delta})\leq(\frac{\epsilon}{4\gamma L})^{2}\tau" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">τ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">δ</mi></mfrac><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mfrac><mi mathvariant="normal">ϵ</mi><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">γ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">τ</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\log(\frac{2\tau|\mathcal{H}|}{\delta})\leq(\frac{\epsilon}{4\gamma L})^{2}\tau</annotation></semantics></math>.
Plug in <math id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tau=C\frac{1}{\epsilon^{2}}\log\frac{2|\mathcal{H}|}{\epsilon^{2}\delta}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">τ</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">ϵ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow><mrow><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">ϵ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">δ</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tau=C\frac{1}{\epsilon^{2}}\log\frac{2|\mathcal{H}|}{\epsilon^{2}\delta}</annotation></semantics></math>, we have that the RHS can be expressed as</span></span></p>

<p id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">The LHS <math id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\log(\frac{2\tau|\mathcal{H}|}{\delta})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>τ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow><mi>δ</mi></mfrac><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\log(\frac{2\tau|\mathcal{H}|}{\delta})</annotation></semantics></math> can be written as</span></p>

<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_eqn_cell"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A4.Ex56Xb.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\leq\log C+2\log(\frac{2|\mathcal{H}|}{\epsilon^{2}\delta})." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mi>C</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow><mrow><msup><mi>ϵ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>δ</mi></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\leq\log C+2\log(\frac{2|\mathcal{H}|}{\epsilon^{2}\delta}).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Pick <math id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="C=3(4\gamma L)^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>C</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>γ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>L</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">C=3(4\gamma L)^{2}</annotation></semantics></math> we will have <math id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="LHS\leq RHS" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>L</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>H</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>S</mi></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mi>R</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>H</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>S</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">LHS\leq RHS</annotation></semantics></math>. Hence
<math id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p3.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tau=\frac{3(4\gamma L)^{2}}{\epsilon^{2}}\log\frac{2|\mathcal{H}|}{\epsilon^{2}\delta}=\mathcal{\tilde{O}}(\epsilon^{-}2)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>τ</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>γ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>L</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><msup><mi>ϵ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow><mrow><msup><mi>ϵ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>δ</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒪</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>ϵ</mi><mo>−</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tau=\frac{3(4\gamma L)^{2}}{\epsilon^{2}}\log\frac{2|\mathcal{H}|}{\epsilon^{2}\delta}=\mathcal{\tilde{O}}(\epsilon^{-}2)</annotation></semantics></math> will safice to bound the risk under <math id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p3.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\epsilon" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>ϵ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\epsilon</annotation></semantics></math>.  <math id="A4.Thmtheorem6.p3.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\square" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi mathvariant="normal">□</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\square</annotation></semantics></math></span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem7" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Proof D.7</span></span></h6>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold ltx_font_italic">Proof of Proposition <a href="#S2.Thmtheorem7" title="Proposition 2.7 ‣ 2.4 Risk Bound and Rates ‣ 2 Algorithm and Performance Guarantees ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.7</span></a><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium">
We prove the two statements separately.</span></span></p>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold ltx_font_italic">Part (a).</span><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">
By Theorem </span><a href="#S2.Thmtheorem5" title="Theorem 2.5 (Risk Bound) ‣ 2.4 Risk Bound and Rates ‣ 2 Algorithm and Performance Guarantees ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref ltx_font_italic"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.5</span></a><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, with probability at least </span><math id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1-\delta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>δ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1-\delta</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p2.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, for all </span><math id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T\geq 1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T\geq 1</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p2.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">,</span></p>

<div id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold ltx_font_italic">Part (b).</span><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">
Fix any </span><math id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\epsilon&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>ϵ</mi><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\epsilon&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> and </span><math id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta\in(0,1)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>δ</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\delta\in(0,1)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">. <p id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">By Theorem </span><a href="#S2.Thmtheorem6" title="Theorem 2.6 (Sample complexity) ‣ 2.4 Risk Bound and Rates ‣ 2 Algorithm and Performance Guarantees ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref ltx_font_italic"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.6</span></a><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.2.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, under the same assumptions as Theorem </span><a href="#S2.Thmtheorem5" title="Theorem 2.5 (Risk Bound) ‣ 2.4 Risk Bound and Rates ‣ 2 Algorithm and Performance Guarantees ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref ltx_font_italic"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.5</span></a><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.2.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, we have that when </span><math id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T\geq\tau" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo>≥</mo><mi>τ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T\geq\tau</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.2.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, with probability at least </span><math id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1-\delta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>δ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1-\delta</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.2.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">,</span></p>
<table id="A4.Ex61" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.Ex61.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h_{T})-R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h^{*})\leq\epsilon." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>R</mi><mtext>SPO</mtext></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>h</mi><mi>T</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><msub><mi>R</mi><mtext>SPO</mtext></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>h</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mi>ϵ</mi></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h_{T})-R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h^{*})\leq\epsilon.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">It remains to verify the claimed asymptotic scaling of </span><math id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tau" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>τ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tau</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.3.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">. Since</span></p>
<table id="A4.Ex62" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.Ex62.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\log\frac{2|\mathcal{H}|}{\epsilon^{2}\delta}=\log\frac{1}{\delta}+\log\frac{2|\mathcal{H}|}{\epsilon^{2}}," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow><mrow><msup><mi>ϵ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>δ</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>δ</mi></mfrac></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow><msup><mi>ϵ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\log\frac{2|\mathcal{H}|}{\epsilon^{2}\delta}=\log\frac{1}{\delta}+\log\frac{2|\mathcal{H}|}{\epsilon^{2}},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">we obtain</span></p>
<table id="A4.Ex63" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.Ex63.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tau=\frac{3(4\gamma L)^{2}}{\epsilon^{2}}\left(\log\frac{1}{\delta}+\log\frac{2|\mathcal{H}|}{\epsilon^{2}}\right)=\mathcal{\tilde{O}}\!\left(\epsilon^{-2}\log\frac{1}{\delta}\right)," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>τ</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>γ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>L</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><msup><mi>ϵ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>δ</mi></mfrac></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow><msup><mi>ϵ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒪</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>ϵ</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>δ</mi></mfrac></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tau=\frac{3(4\gamma L)^{2}}{\epsilon^{2}}\left(\log\frac{1}{\delta}+\log\frac{2|\mathcal{H}|}{\epsilon^{2}}\right)=\mathcal{\tilde{O}}\!\left(\epsilon^{-2}\log\frac{1}{\delta}\right),</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.5" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">where </span><math id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{\tilde{O}}(\cdot)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒪</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">⋅</mo><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{\tilde{O}}(\cdot)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.5.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> hides factors logarithmic in </span><math id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="|\mathcal{H}|" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">|\mathcal{H}|</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.5.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> and </span><math id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1/\epsilon" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>/</mo><mi>ϵ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1/\epsilon</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p3.5.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">. This proves (b).</span></p>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Finally, both (a) and (b) hold on the same <math id="A4.Thmtheorem7.p4.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1-\delta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>δ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1-\delta</annotation></semantics></math> probability event guaranteed by Theorem <a href="#S2.Thmtheorem5" title="Theorem 2.5 (Risk Bound) ‣ 2.4 Risk Bound and Rates ‣ 2 Algorithm and Performance Guarantees ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.5</span></a> and Theorem <a href="#S2.Thmtheorem6" title="Theorem 2.6 (Sample complexity) ‣ 2.4 Risk Bound and Rates ‣ 2 Algorithm and Performance Guarantees ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.6</span></a>, completing the proof.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem8" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem8.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Proof D.8</span></span></h6>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold ltx_font_italic">Proof of Theorem <a href="#S3.Thmtheorem2" title="Theorem 3.2 (Earlier stopping time than decision-blind design) ‣ 3.1 Comparison Under Optimality Gap Assumption ‣ 3 Comparison with Decision-blind Sequential Design ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">3.2</span></a><span id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium">
We consider the two algorithms in turn.</span></span></p>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Regarding the proof of the early stopping of Algorithm <a href="#alg1" title="Algorithm 1 ‣ 2.2 Importance Weighted Sequential Experimental Design ‣ 2 Algorithm and Performance Guarantees ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">1</span></a>, by
Theorem <a href="#S2.Thmtheorem5" title="Theorem 2.5 (Risk Bound) ‣ 2.4 Risk Bound and Rates ‣ 2 Algorithm and Performance Guarantees ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.5</span></a> (with
constant <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c=4\gamma L" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>γ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>L</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">c=4\gamma L</annotation></semantics></math>), for any confidence parameter
<math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta\in(0,1]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>δ</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\delta\in(0,1]</annotation></semantics></math>,</span></p>
<table id="A4.Ex64" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.Ex64.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="\Pr\!\Bigl[R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h_{T})-R_{\textnormal{SPO}}^{\star}\leq c\sqrt{\frac{\log(2T|\mathcal{H}|/\delta)}{T}}\Bigr]\;\geq\;1-\delta." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mpadded style="width:1.090em;" width="1.090em"><mi>Pr</mi></mpadded><mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">[</mo><msub><mi>R</mi><mtext>SPO</mtext></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>h</mi><mi>T</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>R</mi><mtext>SPO</mtext><mo>⋆</mo></msubsup><mo>≤</mo><mi>c</mi><msqrt><mfrac><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>T</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><mi>δ</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mi>T</mi></mfrac></msqrt><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em" rspace="0.280em">]</mo></mrow><mo>≥</mo><mn> 1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>δ</mi><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Pr\!\Bigl[R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h_{T})-R_{\textnormal{SPO}}^{\star}\leq c\sqrt{\frac{\log(2T|\mathcal{H}|/\delta)}{T}}\Bigr]\;\geq\;1-\delta.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Choose
<math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p3.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="\delta_{T}=2T|\mathcal{H}|\,\exp\!\bigl(-\alpha^{2}T/16\gamma^{2}L^{2}\bigr)=2T|\mathcal{H}|\,e^{-k_{1}T}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>δ</mi><mi>T</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>T</mi><mo fence="false" rspace="0.167em" stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo fence="false" rspace="0.337em" stretchy="false">|</mo><mpadded style="width:1.370em;" width="1.370em"><mi>exp</mi></mpadded><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><mo lspace="0em">−</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>T</mi><mo>/</mo><mn>16</mn><msup><mi>γ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><msup><mi>L</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>T</mi><mo fence="false" rspace="0.167em" stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo fence="false" rspace="0.337em" stretchy="false">|</mo><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><msub><mi>k</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>T</mi></mrow></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\delta_{T}=2T|\mathcal{H}|\,\exp\!\bigl(-\alpha^{2}T/16\gamma^{2}L^{2}\bigr)=2T|\mathcal{H}|\,e^{-k_{1}T}.</annotation></semantics></math>
With this choice, we have
<math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c\sqrt{\log(2T|\mathcal{H}|/\delta_{T})/T}=\alpha" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>T</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><msub><mi>δ</mi><mi>T</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><mi>T</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>α</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">c\sqrt{\log(2T|\mathcal{H}|/\delta_{T})/T}=\alpha</annotation></semantics></math>. Hence, we have</span></p>
<table id="A4.Ex65" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.Ex65.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="\Pr\!\bigl[R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h_{T})-R_{\textnormal{SPO}}^{\star}&gt;\alpha\bigr]\;\leq\;\delta_{T}=2T|\mathcal{H}|\,e^{-k_{1}T}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mpadded style="width:1.090em;" width="1.090em"><mi>Pr</mi></mpadded><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">[</mo><msub><mi>R</mi><mtext>SPO</mtext></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>h</mi><mi>T</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>R</mi><mtext>SPO</mtext><mo>⋆</mo></msubsup><mo>&gt;</mo><mi>α</mi><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em" rspace="0.280em">]</mo></mrow><mo rspace="0.558em">≤</mo><msub><mi>δ</mi><mi>T</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>T</mi><mo fence="false" rspace="0.167em" stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo fence="false" rspace="0.337em" stretchy="false">|</mo><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><msub><mi>k</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>T</mi></mrow></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Pr\!\bigl[R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h_{T})-R_{\textnormal{SPO}}^{\star}&gt;\alpha\bigr]\;\leq\;\delta_{T}=2T|\mathcal{H}|\,e^{-k_{1}T}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Because of the optimality gap,
<math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p4.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h_{T})-R_{\textnormal{SPO}}^{\star}\in\{0\}\cup[\alpha,\infty)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>R</mi><mtext>SPO</mtext></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>h</mi><mi>T</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>R</mi><mtext>SPO</mtext><mo>⋆</mo></msubsup></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow><mo>∪</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mi>α</mi><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∞</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h_{T})-R_{\textnormal{SPO}}^{\star}\in\{0\}\cup[\alpha,\infty)</annotation></semantics></math>.
Therefore, for some sufficiently large <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p4.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>T</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T</annotation></semantics></math>,
<math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p4.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T\geq\frac{3(4\gamma L)^{2}}{\alpha^{2}}\log\frac{2|\mathcal{H}|}{\alpha^{2}\delta}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo>≥</mo><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>γ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>L</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><msup><mi>α</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow><mrow><msup><mi>α</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>δ</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T\geq\frac{3(4\gamma L)^{2}}{\alpha^{2}}\log\frac{2|\mathcal{H}|}{\alpha^{2}\delta}</annotation></semantics></math>, with probability <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p4.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1-\delta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>δ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1-\delta</annotation></semantics></math> we have <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p4.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h_{T})-R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h^{*})=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>R</mi><mtext>SPO</mtext></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>h</mi><mi>T</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><msub><mi>R</mi><mtext>SPO</mtext></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>h</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h_{T})-R_{\textnormal{SPO}}(h^{*})=0</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Consequently, after designing <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p5.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>T</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T</annotation></semantics></math> experiments, we have <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p5.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="H_{t}\subseteq\mathcal{H}^{*}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>H</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>⊆</mo><msup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℋ</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">H_{t}\subseteq\mathcal{H}^{*}</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
</div>
<figure id="A4.F16" class="ltx_figure"><img src="2602.05340v1/counterexample.png" id="A4.F16.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_square" style="aspect-ratio:191/213;" width="191" height="213" alt="Refer to caption">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering ltx_font_italic"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure"><span id="A4.F16.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_upright" style="font-size:90%;">Figure 16</span>: </span><span id="A4.F16.6" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">An Example of a Distribution Under Which a Decision-Blind Algorithm Results in a Later Stopping Time</span></figcaption>
</figure>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Next, to show that Algorithm <a href="#alg3" title="Algorithm 3 ‣ Appendix A Benchmark Algorithms ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">3</span></a> may not converge, we consider a setting where the candidate pool contains a single feature value <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>x</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math>, and we assume the ambient space dimension is <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="d\geq 2" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">d\geq 2</annotation></semantics></math>. Consider the specific distribution illustrated in Figure <a href="#A4.F16" title="Figure 16 ‣ Proof D.8 ‣ D.2 Other Proofs. ‣ Appendix D Proofs ‣ Decision-Focused Sequential Experimental Design: A Directional Uncertainty-Guided Approach" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">16</span></a>. Suppose we have two prediction candidates, <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="h_{1}(x)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>h</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h_{1}(x)</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="h_{2}(x)\in\mathbb{R}^{d}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>h</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi>ℝ</mi><mi>d</mi></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h_{2}(x)\in\mathbb{R}^{d}</annotation></semantics></math>, that possess equal norm. Furthermore, assume that the resulting optimal decision variables differ, i.e., <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="w^{*}(h_{1}(x))\not=w^{*}(h_{2}(x))" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>w</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>h</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≠</mo><mrow><msup><mi>w</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>h</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">w^{*}(h_{1}(x))\not=w^{*}(h_{2}(x))</annotation></semantics></math>. Let the conditional expectation <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{E}[c|x]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo fence="false" rspace="0.167em" stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}[c|x]</annotation></semantics></math> be positioned such that it equally divides the angle <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\angle(h_{1}(x),h_{2}(x))" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>h</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>h</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\angle(h_{1}(x),h_{2}(x))</annotation></semantics></math>. Additionally, assume that <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{E}[c|x]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo fence="false" rspace="0.167em" stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}[c|x]</annotation></semantics></math> lies within the same optimal decision cone as <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="h_{1}(x)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>h</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h_{1}(x)</annotation></semantics></math>, which implies <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="w^{*}(h_{1}(x))=w^{*}(\mathbb{E}[c|x])" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>w</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>h</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msup><mi>w</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo fence="false" rspace="0.167em" stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">w^{*}(h_{1}(x))=w^{*}(\mathbb{E}[c|x])</annotation></semantics></math>, making <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="h_{1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>h</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h_{1}</annotation></semantics></math> the optimal prediction model. Suppose the distribution of the cost vector is generated by</span></p>

<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.Ex66.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="c_{t}\;=\;\mathbb{E}[c|x]+\epsilon_{t},\qquad t=1,\dots,T," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>c</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0.558em" rspace="0.558em">=</mo><mi>𝔼</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mi>c</mi><mo fence="false" rspace="0.167em" stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>ϵ</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>T</mi><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">c_{t}\;=\;\mathbb{E}[c|x]+\epsilon_{t},\qquad t=1,\dots,T,</annotation></semantics></math></td>

<p id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">where <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\{\epsilon_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><msub><mi>ϵ</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>T</mi></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\{\epsilon_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T}</annotation></semantics></math> are i.i.d. with <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{E}[\epsilon_{t}]=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>ϵ</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}[\epsilon_{t}]=0</annotation></semantics></math>, coordinatewise constant variance <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.m14" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma_{\epsilon}^{2}\in(0,\infty)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mi>ϵ</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∞</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma_{\epsilon}^{2}\in(0,\infty)</annotation></semantics></math>. Define <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p6.m15" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bar{\Delta}:=h_{2}(x)-h_{1}(x)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo>¯</mo></mover><mo>:=</mo><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>h</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><msub><mi>h</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bar{\Delta}:=h_{2}(x)-h_{1}(x)</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p7" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p7.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Since <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p7.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\|h_{1}(x)\|=\|h_{2}(x)\|" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>h</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>h</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\|h_{1}(x)\|=\|h_{2}(x)\|</annotation></semantics></math> and they equally divide the angle, for any mean <math id="A4.Thmtheorem8.p7.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{E}[c|x]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo fence="false" rspace="0.167em" stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}[c|x]</annotation></semantics></math> we have</span></p>

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
